Brutal Skeleton, Human
CR 1

XP 400
NE Medium undead
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 12, flat-footed 14 (+2 armor, +2 Dex, +2 natural)
hp 5 (1d8+1)
Fort +0, Ref +2, Will +3
DR 5/bludgeoning; Immune cold, undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee broken scimitar +0 (1d6), claw –3 (1d4+1) or 2 claws +2 (1d4+2)

COMBAT

Martial Tradition none; PAM Wis

Duelist Sphere

blooded strike, (deal 1 bleed on attack action, do not provoke Attack of Opportunity on maneuvers vs. bleeding targets, apply one (bleed))

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 14, Con —, Int —, Wis 12, Cha 12
Base Atk +0; CMB +2; CMD 14
Feats: Improved Initiative
SQ brutal combatant
Gear broken chain shirt, broken scimitar

ABOUT

Environment any
Organization any
Treasure none

A brutal undead is a variant skeleton or zombie that can be created using animate dead or the Death sphere Expanded Necromancy talent and count as twice their normal number of Hit Dice when casting the reanimate sphere effect.
